notes.title: FeedBack Fix #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, dear players of [b]WolfGirl RoomMate![/b]

In anticipation of our special Christmas update, we’ve released an intermediate update to enhance your gaming experience. This update includes fixes for some bugs reported by the community and adds new features we hope you’ll enjoy. Here are the details:

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[b]Gallery:[/b] We’ve fixed several bugs in the gallery that could cause abnormal game behavior, such as crashes or images failing to load properly. The gallery is now more stable and smoother than ever.

[h1]New Features And Fixes[/h1]

[b]Windowed Mode:[/b] You can now press F11 to switch the game to windowed mode. This feature allows you to move the game window to other screens, improving convenience for players with multi-monitor setups.

[b]Dialogue Corrections:[/b] We’ve fixed several grammatical errors in the dialogues to make the narrative clearer and more enjoyable.

This update is our early gift as we prepare to introduce the new Christmas scene in the upcoming update. Stay tuned for more news, and as always, thank you for your support and valuable feedback!

Have fun!

The NyakuGames Team

notes.title: WolfGirl RoomMate release and future!
notes.content:
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]

Here we are guys with the release of our fourth game!
Since we released our first game we have always learned new things and understood which direction to move based on the feedback and criticism of the community!

[h1]A RIVISITED ROOM MATE[/h1]
This RoomMate has all the features of the previous ones plus additions and improvements based on the feedback collected so far.
It also has a completely revisited balance that should make the game more interactive, graphical improvements and a new minigame!

[h1]SUPPORT[/h1]

We recently released a game called Cow Girl cafe, we put a lot of support into it to know where to change the balance of the various power-ups and how to improve the flow of the game and we saw a huge support from the community. So we aim to do the same with this game, we will be very active in the community hub and we will read your feedback every day about the game to better balance it and make it more fun for everyone.

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260100/95098636299dd38218d746691d23658c16b8a6d0.jpg[/img]

We hope this third RoomMate will excite you as much as the previous ones.
Happy gaming everyone!
